end.summary:
Practised the structure of India’s courts and the idea of appeal.
Distinguished civil cases from criminal cases using property, rent, contracts, theft and FIR examples.
Vihaan identified a district court appeal to the Rajasthan High Court with visual support.
Teach-back was not completed; court-structure understanding needed prompting and a diagram.
end.parentNote: Asha practised civil and criminal cases with Vihaan, and they correctly sorted property disputes and theft examples after discussing the clues of disputes, FIRs and punishment. Vihaan also identified that an appeal from Jaipur District Court goes to the Rajasthan High Court, with support from the court-structure diagram. There was some initial mixing up about why cases are civil or criminal, which was corrected during the lesson; the diagram was also difficult to see at first. At home, ask Vihaan to draw and label District Court → High Court → Supreme Court, then give one civil and one criminal example.
